in_marathi.name: Gaurinandan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gaurinandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gauri (goddess of beauty) + Indra (rain god) + Dan (giver of wealth) = Gauri-Nandana, the one who delights Gauri. A name bestowed with the blessings of both the goddess of beauty and the rain god.

A name bestowed with the blessings of both the goddess of beauty and the rain god.
